name: Jio Platforms
summary: Reliance's digital/telecom holding company: Jio (533 mn customers), JioAirFiber (14 mn), proprietary 5G stack; 100% fresh issue, ₹27,500 Cr to repay RJIL debt.
positives: Operating cash flow ₹77,556 Cr in FY26 vs capex ₹34,255 Cr
Largest Indian telecom base; ₹27,500 Cr proceeds cut debt
red_flags: ₹30,213 Cr issue at ~₹10 lakh Cr market cap; ~33x P/E for mid-teens growth
Finance costs doubled to ₹8,653 Cr in FY26; ~₹1.05 lakh Cr spectrum liabilities
anchor: Strong: ₹8,110 Cr; LIC ₹499 Cr, Capital Group New World ₹487 Cr, BNP ODI ₹303 Cr, Fidelity, BlackRock (19 Oct 2026)
